patterns.note: A dark mode aesthetic is used throughout, with content centered horizontally within full-width sections, creating a focused and high-contrast presentation.
Headings are large, bold, and sans-serif, providing strong visual hierarchy, complemented by smaller, lighter body text and occasional uppercase labels for sub-sections.
The primary color scheme relies on a deep black background with white or light gray text, accented by a vibrant orange for call-to-action buttons and interactive elements.
A sticky navigation bar remains at the top of the viewport during scroll. Content sections reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport.
Feature sections are presented with a clear structure, pairing a prominent headline with a visual (often a screenshot or graphic) and concise descriptive text.

technique_notes: The hero section features a large, interactive 3D graphic built with WebGL/Three.js, serving as a dynamic visual centerpiece that immediately conveys the product's technical nature.
Content sections are animated to appear with a staggered fade-up effect as they scroll into view, using CSS keyframes to create a smooth and engaging reveal.
A persistent top navigation bar is implemented to stick to the top of the browser window, ensuring key actions like 'Get access' are always visible.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body text) create strong impact, paired with smaller, lighter body text for readability and occasional uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Rounded corners are consistently applied to buttons, input fields, and accordion items, ranging from subtle to rounded, contributing to a modern and approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical padding between major sections and within the hero, creating clear visual separation and a clean layout.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its prominent, interactive 3D WebGL graphic in the hero section, which immediately communicates the product's advanced technical capabilities and creates a memorable, high-tech first impression. This sophisticated visual, combined with a polished dark mode, elevates it beyond a standard marketing site.
